body: Airbus launched a strong aircraft into a market where many airlines already knew what they wanted. The 777-300ER had been the benchmark for large, long-range twinjets for years, and the 777X was positioned as its natural heir, so many carriers simply decided to wait. The A350-1000 offered higher fuel efficiency and a newer composite airframe, but it arrived with a modest order book and no obvious must-have customer beyond its launch operator, Qatar Airways.

The turning point was the 777X delay. The aircraft was meant to enter service in 2020 and is now targeted for 2027, roughly seven years late. By June, Airbus data showed the A350-1000 had 367 orders and 114 deliveries. Air Canada offers the clearest example of the shift: in February 2026, the carrier placed a firm order for eight A350-1000s, with rights to eight more, securing delivery slots from the second half of 2030.

Range is one clear advantage. The A350-1000 is listed at roughly 8,700 nautical miles, while the 777-9 is rated for about 7,285 nautical miles, a difference of about 1,400 nautical miles. The A350-1000 is already in production, while the 777-9 is still awaiting its first customer handover. Airbus is also studying a stretched version, informally called the A350-2000, which it presented at the 2025 Dubai Airshow. Rolls-Royce still has to address engine concerns: Airbus outlined an additional durability package for the Trent XWB-97, targeting up to double the time on wing from 2028, although the presentation does not show that improvement has already been achieved in operational service.
en.summary: The Airbus A350-1000 entered service with Qatar Airways in 2018 but spent years in the shadow of the Boeing 777-300ER and the not-yet-delivered 777X. With the 777X now targeted for 2027, about seven years late, the A350-1000's orders and deliveries have finally picked up.
en.title: Why the A350-1000 is finally gaining ground on Boeing's delayed 777X

body: A350-1000在2018年隨卡達航空投入服務，但當時許多航空公司已有明確機隊選擇，777-300ER長期是大型長程雙走道客機的標竿，777X又被定位為其自然接班人，許多業者因此選擇等待。A350-1000具備較佳燃油效率與較新的複合材料機身，但初期訂單有限，除了首家業者外缺乏明顯的關鍵客戶，銷售因此長期緩慢。
轉折來自777X的延宕。777X原定2020年投入服務，現已延至2027年，約晚7年；到今年6月為止，空中巴士數據顯示A350-1000累計訂單367架、已交機114架。加拿大航空於2026年2月確定訂購8架A350-1000並取得另外8架選擇權，交機時段為2030年下半年起，顯示大型雙走道客機的交機排程已相當緊張。

A350-1000的航程約8700海里，777-9約7285海里，兩者相差約1400海里，對講求載重不受限的超長程瘦長航線別具意義；A350-1000已進入量產，而777-9仍在等待首架交機。空中巴士也正研究加長型A350-2000，並於2025年杜拜航空展提出相關構想，目標填補A350-1000與777X之間的空缺。勞斯萊斯仍須處理TrentXWB-97發動機耐用度疑慮，空中巴士在今年10月簡報中提出額外耐用度方案，目標是自2028年起將在翼時間最多提升至約兩倍，但該目標尚未在實際營運中實現。
zh.summary: 空中巴士A350-1000於2018年由卡達航空率先投入服務，卻長期活在波音777-300ER與尚未交機的777X陰影下；隨著777X交機目標從2020年延至2027年，A350-1000訂單與交機量終於明顯回升。
zh.title: A350-1000為何終於翻身：波音777X延宕改寫長程機市場
